alignments.note: One יֵשׁ scopes over both cola and the ASV writes *There is* at the head of each; both realizations are its one discontinuous unit under rule 25, headed on the first. The supplied *There* is the frame's, so the head goes on the copula.

Hitpael participle recast substantivally: the supplied *that* is rule 46's, the reflexive *himself* renders the verb's own voice under rule 44, and the head is the word carrying the lexeme. Margin *Or, feigneth* read and set aside.

The negative existential and כֹּל are rendered by the single word *nothing*, which carries both the negation and the quantification, so they share one unit under rule 35, headed on the negative; the *hath* is the existential frame under rule 50.
Second participle read exactly as the first. Margin *Or, feigneth* read and set aside.
The second colon writes no הָיָה, no possessive preposition, no suffix and no verb the *hath* renders, so nothing makes the clause possessive and the supplied verb is added under rule 43.

review_notes: The second *There is* is placed with the one written יֵשׁ under rule 25's distributed scope; the second *hath* is added because the second colon holds no morpheme to carry it.
